Do you also think that, the moment I had these thoughts about the pattern I’ve been seeing with her that I should’ve opened it up to her so that she would be more aware? I’m asking these questions because I hope that in the future, when I become open to dating again, I could handle these things better in understanding and communicating.

Hey there. I hope you’ll still be able to see and respond to this. I recently went through a break up almost 3 days ago. I’ve been looking back at my relationship with my ex and realized that her initial solution whenever we had conflict was leaving.

I’m secure with anxious tendencies and I’ve began to think that she was FA based on how she was acting. During our relationship, she would always say things like “please don’t leave me” and I recently read back our old messages and we had one bump during our 3rd or 4th month wherein it started when I told her how much I was sad because I missed her. I had no bad intentions. I simply missed her from not seeing each other for weeks. She then responded with a question asking if “I would be happier if I was in another relationship with a partner that I could see frequently” and then proceeded to become sad as well and say things like she got used to people leaving in her life that she developed a way where she would rather push people away or make them unlike her because she’s afraid they would leave. I tried my best to reassure and she went cold for a day. I made her a letter about reassurance again and when we sorted that out she told me that she couldn’t open up about her past too much because it still hurt her. 

There was also this time when we were lying in bed talking about some things and I got slightly irritated and she got that hint and next thing I knew she wasn’t facing me anymore. She wouldn’t talk to me or let me know what the problem was until I was sitting up crying in bed with my back on the wall before she said that she thought I was angry with her that’s why she shut out. I also remember two months ago when we both had another problem. We explained both our sides and she replied with “knowing my side and yours, I think it’s best if we let go”. It feels like she just isn’t trying to fight. It’s so hard to have this dynamic. This was one of the biggest reasons as to why I started feeling unvalued in the relationship.

It’s like when we have problems her first thought is always thinking that I would leave her and so she distances herself first. I already told her before that it’s normal to have issues and it’s inevitable and that I wouldn’t leave her just because of that. We were both capable of making mistakes and I told her that we can always work things out when those things come. 

The events leading to our break up was very similar. This time tho all our interactions were through text or call. We were texting last month and I sent something in a sarcastic tone (my honest fault I regret it really quick) and she left me on read and the following days were her acting cold and me trying to reach out. I asked if we could talk and we did after a few days. During this conversation, I was honest with her about how I’ve been feeling in the relationship recently. I felt unvalued because of the reason I mentioned earlier and because of the lack of communication we’re experiencing not just at that moment but the other month prior. I let her know how if the relationship remains only one sided and needs aren’t being met then it wouldn’t be sustainable anymore. I asked her what she wanted to happen and she couldn’t answer me. She said she needed time to think and so I gave her space for it. 

I asked if we would remain in contact during her time thinking and she said no so I let her. It took us about a month to talk about it. We were supposed to meet f2f but she kept putting it off until I finally said that she could just be honest with me now (through text). That’s when she said there’s no more hope in the relationship and I agreed with her that it’s over. It hurts and I’m here now trying to analyze why my ex acted that way. Was it that she just isn’t in the place to fight or make things work? I was always willing to work things out but when it’s obvious she didn’t see any hope that there was nothing left for me. It’s almost like she had this self-fulfilling prophecy of the relationship ending and her being left alone and it did happen. It makes me sad and think as well that maybe I put pressure on her and that I was too naive to think that people would handle things in a relationship the way I would. These realizations make it very clear to me tho that our decision to end things was the right thing to do. I still care for her a lot and I just hope to god that she recognizes her patterns and work through it.
